recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The occult is psychology wearing a mask", "body": "Chance Garton opens by arguing that whatever is real in what people call the occult, the hidden, is simply psychology, the psyche of the individual, the collective, and the universe itself. He points out that you cannot separate the most famous psychologists of the modern age from myth and the hidden arts. Freud wrote Moses and Monotheism, Jung wrote endlessly about alchemy and the image making faculty of consciousness. From there he frames mythographers, priest classes, kings and tyrants as masters of universal psychology who either play to a people's strengths or prey upon their weaknesses."}, {"title": "Gurdjieff, the Sufis, and the beehive", "body": "Gabriel, who goes by Slick Dissident, walks through the Enneagram's contested history. It reaches the modern world through Gurdjieff, who credited a Sufi sect whose name translates roughly as the keepers of the bees. Gabriel finds that thrilling because the Beehive Cluster sits in Cancer, which he ties to the Chariot card and its gilded gold. A rival lineage claims independent South American discovery. The personality matrix, he notes, was layered onto the older figure fairly recently, which is why the system now lives mostly in self help circles rather than initiate ones."}, {"title": "How the nine numbers actually divide", "body": "The heart of the episode is the map. The big Y splits the circle into three trines. Eights, nines and ones are instinct, body and the present moment. Twos, threes and fours are feeling and the past. Fives, sixes and sevens are thinking and the future, and the four to five crossing is the pivot of the whole figure. A second grouping sorts the numbers into compliant, aggressive and withdrawn. Gabriel adds that the seven deadly sins form the base, with deceit and fear added for three and six, and that dividing anything by seven yields 142857 repeating."}, {"title": "Star Wars as a tarot deck in motion", "body": "Gabriel's project overlays the Thoth Crowley tarot and Star Wars onto the nine stations. Luke Skywalker is the Fool and the perfectionist one, alongside Athena and her shadow brother Ares, and Zeus when he must fight Typhon. Chewbacca is the Magi and the giver, always repairing, always saying yes, a willing slave whose pride roars. Princess Leia and Dionysus hold the achiever three with its shadow of deceit. Han Solo, married to the Empress as the Millennium Falcon, is the emperor and the individual four, driven by envy. Obi Wan Kenobi sits at five, the observer."}, {"title": "Feeding the demon of a number", "body": "Both men keep returning to how this knowledge could be used against people. Chance Garton describes collectivism as the shadow of oneness and traces it through the one percent slogan, MAGA loyalty that survived Warp Speed, and January 6th, arguing that righteous indignation is the easiest lever for moving crowds. He predicts pride parades oscillating into wrath parades. Gabriel goes further, suggesting that childhood images like Chewbacca choking Lando Calrissian can be summoned decades later around events like George Floyd. Their closing warning, echoing The Prisoner, is blunt. You are not a number."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Slick Dissident, the symbolic syncretism master sleuth, returns to InnerVerse for a deep dive into the esoteric enneagram. We'll be exploring the light and shadow archetypes of the nine divines, and exploring the digital significance of such knowledge being used by occultists over the long spans of human existence.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension we continue analyzing the enneagram, using Star Wars and mythology as our frameworks for allegorical understanding. It's a huge 1.5+ hour extension!
